pages.text: Crafted from Mystery Ingots, cobblestone and a crafting table.

The altar has no slots: $(l)drop the materials on the ground$() within 5 blocks of it, then $(l)right-click the altar$().$(br2)If the materials are enough, they are transmuted and the result is shown in chat. Using an altar for the first time unlocks the Mystery Energy HUD.
When several recipes match, the altar crafts the $(l)highest tier$() first (S+ > S > A+ > ... > D).$(br2)With JEI installed, every altar recipe can be browsed in JEI.
